# Independent review of native job draft (#388)

**Verdict: revise.** Reviewed candidate `24a97d293da374ab0cf205cf63a4a1ac4d280a55` in tree `c23ed903ca70d3eb260f672b334ef42ea60e930c`; path history identifies four draft additions. No explicit author baseline was staged.
Actual reviewer model family: **OpenAI GPT (Codex)**. This report makes no native execution, readiness, or benchmark quality claim.

## Standards
3. **Medium — cross-family review remains outstanding.** [README.md:3](../benchmark/native/job/README.md#L3) requests cross-family review before installation; this reviewer and the author are both GPT family. Obtain another-family review or explicitly revise that process requirement.
No other documented standards violation was established within the bounded evidence scope.

## Spec
1. **High — the intended readiness workflow remains incomplete.** [native_job.py:173](../benchmark/native/job/native_job.py#L173) and lines 199–201,306–314 retain gaps for independently known behaviour, typed native properties, verified diagram content, controlled I/O and independent comparison. The documentation acknowledges these gaps; retain the installation block until independently reviewed operations and fixtures resolve them.
2. **High — diagram evidence is unavailable to a separate session.** [workflow.proposal.yml:38](../benchmark/native/job/workflow.proposal.yml#L38) excludes collected HTML. This blocks reviewable diagram-capture evidence and substantive separate diagram comparison. Add explicit `reports/*.html` uploads; support exact PNG companion paths only after verifying and extending the output contract. Keep VI files excluded.
The [complete exact-clause map and safety quotations](artifacts/native-job-review.md) document preservation/status checks, matching image digest and Docker options, dispatch-only triggering, contents: read, persist-credentials: false, and no VI upload paths. README's map omits the opening known-behaviour dispatch clause and final compile-only exclusion; add both. Other gaps are accurately disclosed.
Every novel CLI operation/parameter (`PrintToSingleFileHtml`, `-VIPath`, `-HTMLFilePath`) is explicitly marked **unverified** in README:23; other CLI options have repository precedent. Safe loading and no-save behaviour remain unverified.
Verification: repository and temporary baselines exited 0; disabling each of the five rejection checks in separate temporary copies caused exit 1 with the corresponding `Accepted rejecting mutation` assertion. No mutation survived; [probe evidence](artifacts/native-job-review.md) includes the discarded shallow-copy attempt. No repository source was edited and Docker was not run.

## What next
Policymaker should resolve findings 1–2 through separately reviewed design changes, then obtain the requested cross-family review before proposing owner installation. Resume from the linked clause map, safety evidence and successful mutation probes; avoid the invalid shallow temporary-copy layout and do not treat synthetic checks as native evidence.
